plugins.name: cpu-temp
plugins.title: CPU Temperature
plugins.description: Adds the printer's Rockchip CPU as a Klipper temperature_sensor so its temperature shows up in the web UI alongside the hotend and bed. Read-only monitoring, no fan control. Works only on the Rockchip-based Snapmaker U1.
plugins.tagline: Show the Rockchip SoC temperature in Fluidd & Mainsail.

plugins.name: object-processing
plugins.title: Object Processing
plugins.description: Turns on Moonraker's enable_object_processing so adaptive bed mesh gets per-object data. Enabling 'Exclude Object' in your slicer is preferred; this can cause long processing times and high memory use on very large gcode files (> 100MB).
plugins.tagline: Enable Moonraker object processing for adaptive mesh.

plugins.name: purge-line-back
plugins.title: Purge Line at Back
plugins.description: Relocates the print-start purge line from the front of the build plate to the back, keeping it clear of the printed part. Overrides the stock SM_PRINT_START_LINE_EXTRUDER_* macros for all four tools. Works only on the Snapmaker U1.
plugins.tagline: Move the print-start purge line to the back of the bed.
